name: F. E. Bowen
bio: F. E. Bowen was a rising Mandan attorney who did business in Medora in October 1884. In October 1886 he was named for district attorney.
mentions: F. E. Bowen, one of Mandan's rising attorney's, was in Medora a few days ago on business. He will be an early passenger to the Hills via the stage line.
…itory, September [15?], 1885. GEORGE W. HARMON, Sheriff of Morton County, By EDW. P. DRURY, His Deputy. F. E. BOWEN AND [E. C. Rice?], Plaintiffs' Attorneys.
